label: Freshdesk
description: Find, create, and update tickets, contacts, companies, and help articles in one helpdesk.
securityDescription: Freshdesk connects with an API key and helpdesk subdomain entered on Composio's hosted page; Chickpea never receives the key. Agents act as the Freshdesk agent who owns the key and can read what that agent can see. With write access, Agents can create and update tickets, contacts, and companies, add private notes, reply to tickets, and draft help articles. A reply goes only to the ticket's requester, and a new ticket's requester must be an existing contact or have no email address. Agents cannot forward tickets, send outbound email, add recipients or email addresses, choose the sending address, or notify anyone about a note. They cannot delete anything, change a ticket's requester or a contact's phone, social, or external IDs, assign tickets to agents or groups, act as another user, make notes public, publish articles, widen which tickets a contact can see, move a contact or ticket to another company or parent ticket, or manage agents, groups, roles, SLAs, or canned responses.

drop.FRESHDESK_CREATE_TICKET_OUTBOUND_EMAIL: Emails a new ticket to any address the Agent names. The recipient is the tool's purpose, so no schema bound keeps it inside the helpdesk.
drop.FRESHDESK_REPLY_TO_FORWARD_TICKET: Sends the ticket conversation to any address the Agent names; to_emails is required, so the recipient cannot be withheld.

capabilities.description: Creates a new ticket in Freshdesk. REQUIRED FIELDS: - subject and description are always required - At least ONE requester identifier is REQUIRED: requester_id (an existing contact; find it with a contact search first), phone, facebook_id, twitter_id, or unique_external_id. A new email address cannot be added. CONDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS: - If phone is provided for a new requester, name becomes MANDATORY NOTE ON ATTACHMENTS: - attachments field expects multipart/form-data format, not file paths

capabilities.description: Tool to retrieve profile information for the currently authenticated agent. Use when you need to get details about the agent whose API credentials are being used for authentication.

capabilities.description: Tool to retrieve all contact fields configured in Freshdesk. Use when you need to get the complete list of contact field definitions including default fields (name, email, phone, etc.) and custom fields with their metadata.

Tool to retrieve all contacts from a Freshdesk account. Use when you need to list contacts, optionally filtered by email, phone, mobile, company, state, or modification date. Results are paginated; iterate through pages using `page` and `per_page` (max 100) to retrieve the full dataset.

page.description: Page number for pagination. Starts at 1. Default: 1.

phone.description: Filter contacts by phone number. Should contain only numeric values; avoid characters like '-', '+', '(', ')'

mobile.description: Filter contacts by mobile number. Should contain only numeric values; avoid characters like '-', '+', '(', ')'

per_page.description: Number of contacts to return per page. Maximum: 100. Default: 30.

company_id.description: Filter contacts belonging to a specific company by company ID

updated_since.description: Retrieve contacts modified after a specified timestamp in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ)

capabilities.description: Tool to search and filter tickets in Freshdesk using flexible query syntax. Use when you need to find tickets based on status, priority, tags, custom fields, dates, or other ticket attributes with complex filtering logic.

page.description: Page number for pagination. Starts at 1 and cannot exceed 10. Default: 1. Each page returns up to 30 results. Maximum 300 tickets can be retrieved across all pages.

query.description: Query string to filter tickets using field:value syntax. Wrap conditions in parentheses for grouping. Use AND, OR for logic. Use :> (≥) and :< (≤) for numeric/date comparisons. Use null for empty fields. String values need single quotes. Do NOT include outer double quotes - they are added automatically. Max 512 characters.

sort_by.description: Field to sort tickets by, e.g., 'created_at'

created_since.description: Retrieve tickets created since this timestamp. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ

query.description: Query string to filter contacts. IMPORTANT: The entire query must be wrapped in double quotes. Format: "field:value" for strings or "field:number" for numeric values. Limited to 512 characters. Use "field:null" to search for null values.
